title: Single-Coordinate Activation Steering for Controllable Social Stance in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Steering one neuron of a small language model can impose a topic or a quirk without training, yet replications show that many published single-neuron recipes are fragile or nonspecific. This paper asks whether an interpersonal stance can be controlled in this manner. The stance studied is a distant crush, a chatbot character that is guarded, intermittently warm and inconsistent. In Qwen3.5, 4B, contrasting activations on hand-written guarded and eager replies identified neuron 7515 of layer 9 as a candidate for controlling this stance. Increasing this neuron activation made the characters replies more distant. Three language models rated this change as stronger than the effects of changing randomly selected neurons, and a blind human comparison supported the finding. Changing the interventions direction between messages also shifted replies between warmer and more distant styles. This suggests that a language model conversational stance

translated_title: 单坐标激活引导实现语言模型中可控的社交立场
translated_abstract: 引导小型语言模型的单个神经元可以在无需训练的情况下赋予模型特定话题或怪癖，然而复现实验表明，许多已发表的单神经元方法是脆弱的或缺乏特异性的。本文探讨了这种形式是否能够控制人际立场。所研究的立场是一种“疏远的暗恋”（distant crush），即一个保持戒备、时而热情且前后不一致的聊天机器人角色。在 Qwen3.5 4B 模型中，通过对比手写的疏远与热切回复的激活，识别出第 9 层的第 7515 号神经元作为控制该立场的候选神经元。提高该神经元的激活值会使角色的回复变得更加疏远。三个语言模型将这一变化评定为比改变随机选择的神经元所产生的效果更强，盲测的人类对比实验也支持了这一发现。在消息之间改变干预的方向，也能使回复在更热情与更疏远的风格之间切换。这表明语言模型的对话立场
tldr: 该论文发现仅需提高语言模型中单个神经元（Qwen3.5 4B 第9层第7515号神经元）的激活，无需任何训练即可控制模型的社交立场，使其回复在疏远与热情之间切换，并通过模型评分与盲测人类对比验证了该效果显著优于随机神经元干预。
en_tdlr: The paper demonstrates that increasing the activation of a single neuron (neuron 7515 of layer 9 in Qwen3.5 4B) can control a language model's social stance without any training, shifting its replies between distant and warm styles, an effect validated by model-based ratings and blind human comparison as significantly stronger than random-neuron interventions.
